allies.rationale_text: Feynman-technique helps johari-window expose what someone only thinks they know by making understanding simple enough to fail visibly.
allies.source_quote: Combining the Johari principle ... with the Feynman Technique ... provides a robust way to ensure genuine comprehension and overcome the tendency to believe you know more than you do.
allies.affinity_rationale: Complementary gap-discovery mechanisms — 'combining the Johari principle (external feedback reveals gaps) with the Feynman Technique (self-explanation reveals gaps) provides a robust way to ensure genuine comprehension'.
allies.activation_condition: When blind spots need to be surfaced through both external feedback (Johari) and self-explanation testing (Feynman) rather than relying on a single discovery channel

allies.rationale_text: Systems-thinking helps johari-window treat blind spots as recurring coordination failures in the whole group, not just as isolated personality flaws.
allies.source_quote: It helps build the capacity of the organization to manage itself in the future.
allies.affinity_rationale: The Johari Window aligns with the Outside View — 'anchoring one's view to the general truth independent of one's subjective perspective' — systems thinking provides the structural framework for this perspective shift.
allies.activation_condition: When self-awareness needs to be grounded in systemic understanding of how one's role and position create predictable blind spots within the larger organizational system

antagonists.rationale_text: Confirmation-bias undermines johari-window when feedback intake is filtered to protect the current self-image.
antagonists.source_quote: johari-window conflicts with confirmation-bias (confirmation bias) when feedback intake is filtered to protect existing self-image.
antagonists.affinity_rationale: System 1 relies on heuristics and is prone to motivated reasoning — the Johari Window 'acts as a System 2 intervention' to block errors that originate in automatic, confirmation-seeking processing.
antagonists.activation_condition: When feedback intake is filtered to protect existing self-image rather than genuinely updating the model of self through uncomfortable but accurate external information
